preconditions_before_any_policy_checkpoi: Gate 00D passes or has user-accepted faithful blocker evidence for reference-video tactile semantics
Gate 00E passes with base grasp/lift/hold and dense tactile/mechanics evidence
Gate 00F passes official UniVTAC/TaCauchy/IsaacLab TacSL semantic sanity or has user-accepted faithful blockers
A Curiosity-owned tmux-held Slurm allocation is available for any model loading, dataset conversion, training, evaluation, or rendering
No dependency installation or package build occurs on compute nodes

required_fields_before_promotion: head RGB sequence compatible with T-Rex slow image stream
left and right wrist or equivalent fast-view RGB streams, or a documented faithful adaptation
state/action contract compatible with eef-62 or a documented adapter with validation
high-frequency tactile F6 history shaped as hands/fingers/6-axis wrench, not scalar contact count
deformation or tactile image sequence aligned with tactile force history
episode timing metadata proving slow/fast clock alignment
normalization statistics comparable to the checkpoint's expected stats
trex_bridge_contract.minimum_valid_first_claim: official checkpoint loads and runs on a schema-valid converted held-out batch; no policy success claim before held-out rollout metrics beat baseline without safety regression

ftp1_baseline_contract.role: future serious general tactile policy baseline
required_before_use: zarr conversion spec for Newton dense visuo-tactile episodes
normalization stats and checkpoint asset compatibility
held-out comparison against Newton base and T-Rex bridge when available

representation_baseline_contract.role: tactile encoder or force-field representation comparison
required_before_use: checkpoint access or documented official blocker
input channel mapping from Newton tactile maps to optical tactile representation inputs
ablation showing representation adds value beyond vision-only and scalar contact proxies

forbidden_shortcuts: do not hand-roll a toy VQ-VAE or transformer and call it T-Rex
do not rename Newton proxy contact counts into T-Rex F6
do not claim curiosity success from checkpoint loading, lower training loss, or a single rendered video
do not start real curiosity training before the tactile/base gates are closed
